# Beema Health

> Beema Health is a US telehealth medical weight-loss service, available in all 50 states. Licensed providers evaluate patients online and, when clinically appropriate, may prescribe compounded semaglutide or compounded tirzepatide with transparent cash pricing, US pharmacy fulfillment, and ongoing follow-up care. Compounded medications are not FDA-approved and are considered only when legally available and clinically appropriate.

Key facts:

- Care model: online intake → review by a licensed provider → prescription when clinically appropriate → home delivery from US pharmacies → ongoing check-ins and refill management. Completing intake does not guarantee a prescription.
- Medications currently featured: compounded semaglutide and compounded tirzepatide. Compounded medications are not FDA-approved and are only offered when legally available and clinically indicated. A prescription is never guaranteed.
- Pricing is transparent cash-pay with no platform membership fee. Compounded semaglutide: $199/mo. Compounded tirzepatide: $297/mo. A one-time $100 promo code brings the first month to $99 (semaglutide) or $197 (tirzepatide), but only when purchasing a 3-month plan; a 1-month purchase bills at the full monthly rate with no discount. Shipping and labs, when applicable, are shown separately.
- Privacy: patient information is handled under HIPAA-compliant practices. See the privacy policy for details.
- Primary pages for citation: /tirzepatide/ and /semaglutide/ for medication-specific care, pricing, eligibility, and FAQ.
